test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the word that fills in the blank correctly and completes the following sentence meaningfully.

In order to attract new readers and increase sales, the publishers of Stephen Hawking's books have asked a few scientists to rewrite some of his books and _______ them ________ so non-science readers can understand them.
solution:
The correct answer is: **dumb, down**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"dumb"** refers to making something simpler or easier to understand, especially by reducing its complexity. (मूर्ख, सरल)

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher had to dumb down the lesson for the younger students.
 
 
 
• **"Down"** in this context means making something less difficult or more accessible. (कम करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The author decided to dumb down the technical terms to make the book accessible to everyone.
 
 
 
• Hence, "dumb down" means to simplify a complex concept to make it easier for a wider audience to understand. (सरल करना)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **dumb, down**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Beat, in** (मारना, में): This phrase does not fit in this context. "Beat in" generally means to incorporate or blend, which doesn't align with simplifying a concept.

 
 
• **Example:** She beat the eggs in with the flour to make the batter.
 
 
 
• **Dig, in** (खोदना, में): "Dig in" refers to starting to eat, or focusing intently on something, not simplifying complex material.
 
 
• **Example:** They dug in their heels and refused to leave the table until their demands were met.
 
 
 
• **Push, down** (धक्का देना, नीचे): "Push down" means to apply force to something to lower it physically, which is unrelated to simplifying material for readers.
 
 
• **Example:** He pushed down the lever to start the machine.
